recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒性前驅細胞（前骨髓細胞到骨髓細胞階段）的細胞質正常帶顆粒，但核卻分成二到四個分離的圓形核塊（雙核／多核），且數量很多，提示藥物（醫源性）造成的顆粒球核分裂異常。
features: Granulocytic precursors (promyelocyte/myelocyte stage) with two to four discrete round nuclear lobes or separate nuclei
Cytoplasm retains pink-violet secondary/primary granulation and pale perinuclear zone, indicating otherwise normal cytoplasmic maturation
Nuclear chromatin moderately condensed in each nuclear fragment; no nucleoli evident
Abnormal forms are numerous (panel B shows a cluster), with occasional mature segmented neutrophils and eosinophils
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (two panels) shows numerous granulocytic precursors at the promyelocyte-to-myelocyte stage that contain two to four separate, round nuclear lobes while their cytoplasm shows preserved granulation. The abnormal cells occur in clusters, with scattered normal-appearing segmented neutrophils and eosinophils. Blasts are not increased in these fields. In the appropriate clinical setting these findings are suggestive of a drug-induced (iatrogenic) nuclear abnormality of granulopoiesis rather than a primary dysplastic process; correlation with the medication history is essential.

ddx.vs: MDS typically shows hypogranular cytoplasm, pseudo-Pelger nuclei and multilineage dysplasia with clonal cytogenetics, rather than uniformly granulated precursors with multiple round nuclei that resolve after drug withdrawal.
Megaloblastic granulopoiesis shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with open chromatin and megaloblastic erythroid precursors, not discrete binucleate myelocytes.
APL cells are atypical promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, Auer rod bundles and a monotonous population, whereas here cells show orderly maturation to neutrophils.
